plugin.name: Splinter Cell Double Agent PCSX2F Widescreen Fix
MAIN.SkipIntro.description: Skips the logo movie at startup. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
HUD.HudScale.description: Scale the UI within its aspect-correct area. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
HUD.WidescreenHud.description: Move gameplay HUD elements to the display edges, including each co-op player’s half. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
